en: A sepia-toned image showing an old European street scene. On the left, there is a building with an ornate onion-dome turret and a statue on top, likely of Baroque or similar architectural style. The street curves with several multi-story buildings that have steeply pitched tiled roofs and classical facades. People are walking in period attire, suggesting an early 20th-century setting. On the right are large, distinctive stone archways and storefronts with signage.
